006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import java.math.BigInteger;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.NonNegativeIntegerItemImpl;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
015import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
017
018/**
019 * An atomic Metapath item containing a non-negative integer data value.
020 */
021public interface INonNegativeIntegerItem extends IIntegerItem {
022  /**
023   * The integer value "1".
024   */
025  @NonNull
026  INonNegativeIntegerItem ONE = valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(BigInteger.ONE));
027  /**
028   * The integer value "0".
029   */
030  @NonNull
031  INonNegativeIntegerItem ZERO = valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(BigInteger.ZERO));
032
033  /**
034   * Get the type information for this item.
035   *
036   * @return the type information
037   */
038  @NonNull
039  static IAtomicOrUnionType<INonNegativeIntegerItem> type() {
040    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.NON_NEGATIVE_INTEGER.getItemType();
041  }
042
043  @Override
044  default IAtomicOrUnionType<? extends INonNegativeIntegerItem> getType() {
045    return type();
046  }
047
048  /**
049   * Create an item from an existing integer value.
050   *
051   * @param value
052   *          a string representing an integer value
053   * @return the item
054   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
055   *           if the provided value is not a non-negative integer
056   */
057  @NonNull
058  static INonNegativeIntegerItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
059    try {
060      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.NON_NEGATIVE_INTEGER.parse(value));
061    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
062      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
063          null,
064          String.format("Invalid non-negative integer value '%s'. %s",
065              value,
066              ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
067          ex);
068    }
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Create an item from an existing integer value.
073   *
074   * @param value
075   *          an integer value
076   * @return the item
077   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
078   *           if the provided value is not a non-negative integer
079   */
080  @NonNull
081  static INonNegativeIntegerItem valueOf(@NonNull INumericItem value) {
082    return value instanceof INonNegativeIntegerItem ? (INonNegativeIntegerItem) value : valueOf(value.asInteger());
083  }
084
085  /**
086   * Create an item from an existing integer value.
087   *
088   * @param value
089   *          an integer value
090   * @return the item
091   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
092   *           if the provided value is not a non-negative integer
093   */
094  @SuppressWarnings("null")
095  @NonNull
096  static INonNegativeIntegerItem valueOf(long value) {
097    return valueOf(BigInteger.valueOf(value));
098  }
099
100  /**
101   * Create an item from an existing integer value.
102   *
103   * @param value
104   *          an integer value
105   * @return the item
106   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
107   *           if the provided value is not a non-negative integer
108   */
109  @NonNull
110  static INonNegativeIntegerItem valueOf(@NonNull BigInteger value) {
111    if (value.compareTo(BigInteger.ZERO) < 0) {
112      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
113          null,
114          String.format("Integer value '%s' must not be negative.", value));
115    }
116    return new NonNegativeIntegerItemImpl(value);
117  }
118
119  /**
120   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
121   *
122   * @param item
123   *          the item to cast
124   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
125   *         cast to this type
126   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
127   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
128   */
129  @NonNull
130  static INonNegativeIntegerItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
131    try {
132      return item instanceof INonNegativeIntegerItem
133          ? (INonNegativeIntegerItem) item
134          : item instanceof INumericItem
135              ? valueOf((INumericItem) item)
136              : valueOf(item.asString());
137    } catch (InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
138      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
139    }
140  }
141
142  @Override
143  default INonNegativeIntegerItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
144    return cast(item);
145  }
146}
